relevance_note: The paper describes two Danon families with LAMP2 variants at individual level: "the mother is heterozygous for a novel frameshift mutation (c.1009_1010 delGT), while her affected son is hemizygous".
method_note: Read the whole paper including the converted supplement; built the JSON with a short Python script in scratch, with every value set by hand from reading and spans checked verbatim by script. Most of the paper is mouse and cultured-cell work, which was not extracted. Supplementary Table S1 has the patients as columns: column 1 'Heterozygous mother (I‐1)', column 2 'Hemizygous son (II‐2)'. Spans for the son quote the row from its label through his cell. CONTRADICTION: the mother of family 1 is labelled I-2 in the Results text and Fig. 1 legend but I‐1 in the Table S1 header; label I-2 (used most often) was kept. Lab rows in Table S1 print a normal range (NR) beside each value. CK and transaminases were read against the printed NR (son: CK 2632, ALT 441, AST 403 recorded as elevated; mother: CK 104 recorded as not elevated). The mother's AST 48 is above the printed NR (8-38), while the legend says 'She had no abnormalities in ... liver functions' and her ALT is 25; so her liver function was recorded excluded as the text states and the checklist item 'elevated liver enzymes (transaminases)' was left not reported. Not interpreted (no checklist status): ejection fraction (mother 46.6%, NR 58-76; son 63.6%, NR 57-75), BNP, ventricular volumes, NYHA class I, and 'Age at diagnosis for CVD' (47 and 16), because the paper does not state these as findings or as an age at Danon diagnosis. Table S1 '(–)' symbols are not defined in that table's legend; the mother's excluded muscle, intellectual and liver items rest on the legend sentence 'She had no abnormalities in skeletal muscle function, intellectual ability, and liver functions.' Family 2 proband is labelled 'ref 4 patient' (rule 4: previously published person, cited as 'Nishino I, et al., patient 3' with ref 4); his mother is 'mother of ref 4 patient'. Their variant c.864 + 5 G >C is linked via the Fig. 1e legend ('Pedigree of the second family'); no transcript is stated for this family specifically, so transcript is not reported. Two literature individuals from the Discussion (refs 9 and 10) were included because the paper gives their variant, zygosity and a feature (medial thickening of coronary arteries); sex was not recorded. Not extracted as persons: references 7, 8 and 10 cited for female carriers needing heart transplant and cardioembolic stroke (group-level, no individual detail). Mouse Table S2 and cell-culture data excluded. No stacked ' / ' cells in this paper.
